paper_id: FOOL_ Addressing the Downlink Bottleneck in Satellite Computing with Neural Feature Compression
title: FOOL: Addressing the Downlink Bottleneck in Satellite Computing with Neural Feature Compression
motivation: LEO constellations数据量激增,下行带宽不足且连接窗口短暂,现有方案依赖强假设限制实用性
problem_framing: 在OEC约束下平衡最大化下行数据量、最少假设下游任务、最小化模型风险三个冲突目标
key_insight: 用浅层特征而非图像重建作失真目标,可保留足够信息供任意下游任务同时获高压缩率
method_signature: FOOL神经特征压缩:Profiler+TCR/s度量+并发执行+特征空间重建
evaluation_criteria: TCR/s(像素处理×压缩增益)、下游任务精度、图像重建质量(PSNR/MS-SSIM/LPIPS)、CubeSat可行性
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 纯任务导向编码虽可极低码率但失去泛化能力;有损压缩可能丢弃连专家也无法验证的机器可解读信息
evidence_for_taste: predictive loss is significantly worse than noisy input
may undermine the effectiveness of entire missions
discern the salient signals may lead to false confidence
less structure and detail are present
thinking_moves: 把有损压缩的隐式信息丢弃显式化为可测风险
从互信息递减性质论证浅层特征的必要性
用信息瓶颈原则解释任务特异压缩的本质
引入TCR/s把吞吐量与码率压缩解耦为独立维度
批判性审视SOTAcodec在下游任务上的欺骗性表现
cites_own_work: Frankensplit: Efficient neural feature compression with shallow variational bottleneck injection for mobile edge computing (2024)
